output.summary: Generates a personalized greeting message for a given name.
Use this tool when you need to generate a simple, friendly greeting for a given name using only standard Python libraries.

frontmatter.name: f6_greet
frontmatter.description: Generates a personalized greeting string based on a provided name using Python's standard library.

body.purpose: This tool takes a name and returns a simple, personalized greeting string, ideal for basic user acknowledgments.
inputs: name (string): The name of the person to greet.
body.when_not_to_use: Do not use this tool for complex interactions, business logic, or when external APIs are required.

inputs.mission: Take a name, return a greeting. Stdlib only. Keep error messages simple text without embedded JSON examples.
